title: Existence and uniqueness of the tensor product of two modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts existence and uniqueness of the tensor product as the module representing bilinear maps, with the commuting diagram drawn in the statement (statement lines 1932-1953). The proof builds the module as a quotient of the free module on the product by the bilinearity relations, extends a bilinear map along the basis to get the universal arrow, and then produces the unique comparing isomorphism between two solutions by evaluating the two composites on generators (proof lines 1960-1993). Quotienting the free module by exactly the relations needed for well-definedness is the step that carries existence. H2.
